title: Office of Undergraduate Research & Inquiry (OURI) — Hub (Rice)
description:
OURI is Rice's front door to undergraduate research: it runs the Rice Undergraduate Scholars Program (RUSP), Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowships (SURF), Century Scholars, and the Inquiry Weeks research symposium, and helps students of any major find a faculty mentor and funding. Start here to get matched to a lab.
